This is a classic AI generation flaw where small text details fail. The Router flagged this as a texture anomaly (sev 1.5), but given the explicit gibberish, it warrants a higher penalty. Additionally, there is slight geometric irregularity in the key rows (perspective distortion) and general softness/compression artifacts noted by the perceptual auditor. While the space bar itself is structurally sound (clean topology mask), the surrounding context exhibits typical AI weaknesses in rendering fine textual and geometric details.
